name: qlrisk_price_dividend_swap
title: Price a DividendSwap
description:
Price one Dividend Swap (qlrisk DividendSwap).
Inputs (* required, name=default): maturity*, notional=1000000, strike, quantity, ticker=SPX, currency=USD. In `advanced` also: effective_date, spot, position.
Example: {"maturity": "1Y", "notional": 1000000} gives NPV 0.00 USD (sample market valued 2026-10-09).
